content.title:
Your child wants to do *IPM.*
What is it?
content.subtitle: Three common questions, answered simply.

qa.a: A 5-year integrated management programme at an IIM. Students join right after Class 12 instead of a regular 3-year degree.

qa.q: Which exam does my child need?
qa.a: It depends on the IIM. IPMAT Indore: IIM Indore, Ranchi, Sirmaur, Amritsar, Sambalpur, Shillong and IIFT. JIPMAT: IIM Jammu and Bodh Gaya. IPMAT Rohtak: IIM Rohtak.
The exams test school-level maths and English, against the clock. Starting in Class 11 gives time to build speed before board exams.
qa.note: Always check each IIM's official website for this year's dates and eligibility.
